اصطفوا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَفَوْا (iṣṭafaw) /isˤ.tˤa.faw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
# اُصْطُفُوا (uṣṭufū) /usˤ.tˤu.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
# اِصْطَفُوا (iṣṭafū) /isˤ.tˤa.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
